text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Monday:
- Western Switzerland's airline Swiss World Airways signed a cooperation agreement with American Airlines, which will run SWA's sales and marketing departments.
- Farner Air Transport in Basle, Tulip Air in Rotterdam, Mini-Liner in Bergamo, Italy and Farner Air Transport Hungary in Budapest have formed an alliance now named Farnair Europe.
- Basle-based Bank Sarasin opened a branch in Geneva, Sarasin Geneve SA, an asset management bank for international private clients.
- Some 8,000 people attended the "Rock against Hate" concert at Zurich's Platzspitz, formerly the drug center of Europe, at the weekend.

- Gewerkschaft Druck und Papier, Switzerland's union of printers and paper industry employees, is trying to cut the work week by four hours to 36 hours in an effort to redistribute work and fight unemployment.
- Swiss Minister Adolf Ogi and Swiss Army Brigadier General Peter Arbenz said at a Swiss Officers Society (SOG) meeting that Switzerland needs to contribute more towards international peace.
